svg.title: bon: the five beats inside every search
svg.desc: Generate: eight agent processes write candidates in parallel. Verify: immutable checks pass some and reject others. Agree: at least two verified candidates produce the same output. Counterexample: another model writes a test and cannot split them. Select: the best lands on trunk. Five kinds share this machine: code, counterexample, compaction, scrub, and map.

g.text: Eight agent processes write in parallel.
Each writes a candidate. All at once.
At least two verified candidates. Same output.
Verified is not enough. Outputs must agree.
Another model writes a test. It cannot split them.
No counterexample. The candidates still agree.
The best candidate lands on trunk.
One selected candidate. Verified, agreed code.

svg.text: candidate → a test that breaks it
intent → a blind test of trunk
